title: WaterColor "Sea-Chase" 11 Viridian Park Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. This home is allowed 10 amenity access bands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.- Extraordinary observation deck - Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $25 per day** - Attached carport for shaded off-street parking- Updated 4K TVs - Outdoor fireplace- 6 unique outdoor sitting areas - 4 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Sea-Chase is an elegant mid-century modern home situated on one of the most exceptional lots in WaterColor, making it a prime location to enjoy the views—especially from the extraordinary open-air tower. Just steps from Seaside, this 3-story home is oriented to maximize its serene, private setting while still being close to all the WaterColor amenities. Boasting 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, Sea-Chase sleeps 10 comfortably.When you step into the beautiful living area, you will be swept away by the tall ceilings and elegant décor with beautiful, soft hues of blue. The gourmet kitchen was designed for entertaining with its fantastic counter space, top-of-the-line appliances, and breakfast bar. Next to the kitchen is the formal dining area with a bar and outside access to the back porch, screened-in dining area, and private pool. There is also a bath beside the laundry area with access to the private outdoor shower adjacent to the dipping pool.State-of-the-art washers and dryers are located on the first and second floors.As you travel to the second floor, the long hallway provides access to 2 primary suites that are sure to please with sophisticated décor. Both offer balcony access and large soaking tubs fit for a king! Also on this second floor is a queen room with bench seating along a wall of windows. The last bedroom is a bunk room with 4 twins.One more set of stairs leads to a family room with a TV/DVD system. An office and seating area with views from the tower's large "circle" windows are also on this floor. Follow the spiral staircase to the top deck and a glass of wine with views of Seaside, WaterColor, and more!With easy access to hiking and biking paths, Sea-Chase provides 4 complimentary adult bikes—great for a short ride to WaterColor Beach Club with fantastic dining options. This home is easily one of the most attractive in the area and will book up fast.Don’t miss the chance to enjoy all of WaterColor and Seaside in one convenient location. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom One: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Primary Bedroom Two: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared BathroomWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preservesPLEASE NOTE: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.*Stand alone ice make is not for guest use.*
